name: Shinshinotsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shinshinotsu village emblem in yellow: concentric arcs rising above three wavy lines.
history: Municipal flag of Shinshinotsu, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 4 January 1934.

features.role: Shinshinotsu village emblem — concentric arcs rising above three wavy lines
